title: Studio Bagno's Bathroom Colour Guide
bodyHtml:
Colour has exploded onto the bathroom scene in the past 5 or so years, especially in the tapware world. We have seen an almost endless number of incredible finishes emerge, from matte black to aged copper and bronze. Another great way to add a touch of personality to your bathroom project is with coloured ceramic. 

At Studio Bagno we work with a range boutique factories that still do small production runs, allowing them to make even a single special piece just for you. In our latest black book catalogue we published a definitive guide to colour:

Each product is attached to a unique colour palate, which allows you to quickly cross reference each basin style with available colour options.

Please be aware that a premium of 50% applies to all colours and finishes other than gloss white. Also, due to inherent differences in colour from factory to factory, slight colour variations may occur. 

Below is an example of how the Colour code will appear with a product- In this example the Shard X Oval Basin in "Yellow" is available from the colour palette "Alice" represented with the code "/ALI5"

For more info call us on (02) 9601 1948.

Contact us today if you need help finding the perfect colour combination for your next bathroom project.
